cellId.description: The client-specified unique identifier of the cell.

code.description: The source code to be executed, one or more lines.

silent.description: Execute this code as quietly as possible. This also means #noHistory must be false.

noStoreHistory.description:
Whether to suppress populating history (not `store_history` in the Jupyter protocol). If #silent is true,
this must also be true, otherwise it should generally be false.

returnValue.description:
Return the actual execution value in {@link ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteResult#value} instead of building the
various visualizations and returning them in {@link ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteResult#data}.

userExpressions.description:
A map of names to expressions to be evaluated after execution (`user_expressions` in the Jupyter protocol).

@see ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteResult#userExpressions

name: ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteSpec
